explanation: The Almighty Creator who is the source of light and power for all things, especially highlighted here as the one who commanded light to shine out of darkness.
The truth of God's love and salvation revealed in Jesus Christ, breaking through human confusion and sin.
The state of invisibility, doubt, and death in which the world exists without God's revelation.
Precious values or gifts from God kept within something seemingly worthless; here it refers to the gospel of Christ.
A weak, earthly container (humanity) carrying an infinitely great and holy treasure to show that power comes from God, not human abilities.
External pressure or suffering that threatens to crush the believer but actually serves to demonstrate God's strength through weakness.
The power and effect of death over our bodies in this world, part of the human life journey before the resurrection.
The eternal life that Christ gives, which dwells within the believer even though external circumstances appear mortal.
God's act of making himself known and visible to humanity through Jesus Christ, so that his glory may be seen by all.
The divine honor and radiance belonging to God, which is reflected in the lives of believers as they hold fast to the gospel.
